name: DDLC Relapse
source:
Enter the mind of MC as he awakens at the beginning of the week with the knowledge of Act I's events. See the world through his eyes as he systematically tries (and occasionally fails) to help bring happiness to your favorite Dokis. Will he be able to prevent Sayori's [corrupt text], or will all of his actions simply be in vain?

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/a6k4cj/relapse_full_release_brace_yourselves_boys_and/]Reddit[/url]]
translation:
当MC在本周初醒来时，他会了解第一幕的事件，进入他的脑海。通过他的眼睛看世界，他系统地尝试（有时会失败）帮助你最喜欢的多基人获得幸福。他能否阻止纱世里的[损坏的文字]，或者他的所有行动都将是徒劳的？

[来自[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/a6k4cj/relapse_full_release_brace_yourselves_boys_and/]Reddit[/url]]
